exposure: Time period (early period vs. later period)
cohort: 1713 Chinese pregnant women with severe preeclampsia
finding: Compared to the earlier period (1985-1997), the later period (1998-2010) saw an increase in preterm birth, FGR, oligohydramnios, and abnormal pregnancy outcomes, while fetal distress, postpartum hemorrhage, and eclampsia rates decreased, and cesarean section rates increased in Chinese women with severe preeclampsia.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section increased significantly in later periods for Chinese women with severe preeclampsia, while rates of natural childbirth, forceps extraction, vacuum extraction, and breech extraction decreased.
